# Fgfactory

> > Fgfactory is a mobile game development and art outsourcing studio specializing in Unity-based games, gamification, and interactive applications for iOS and Android.

Fgfactory offers full-cycle game development services including 2D/3D art, animation, gambling games, EdTech solutions, and multiplayer infrastructure. The studio has delivered projects for clients like Long Game, Champion Chess, and Playcrowd using technologies like Unity, React Native, Spine, and PixiJS.

## Key Topics

- Unity game development
- Mobile game outsourcing (iOS/Android)
- Game art and animation services
- Gamification for EdTech and business
- Gambling game development (slots, cards, bingo)
- Cross-platform mobile games
- Multiplayer game infrastructure
- 2D/3D game graphics
- Interactive learning applications
- Financial literacy games
- NFT and blockchain gaming
- React Native game development
- Spine animation
- Full-cycle game development
